description: The accounts for invoices and wallet credit in one currency.

fields.label: Receivable Account
fields.description: Full account name, in this currency. For example Debtors USD - ABBR.

fields.label: Advance Account
fields.description: Where a top-up in this currency is booked until an invoice uses it. A Receivable account under Liabilities, in this currency. For example Customer Advances USD - ABBR.

fields.label: Income Account
fields.description: Where invoice lines in this currency are booked. For example Sales - Global - ABBR.

fields.label: Wallet Clearing Account
fields.description: Bank-type account in this currency. Credit returned to a wallet passes through it, so no cash moves.

name: Accounting Receivable Account
